newsitem.title: FINLAND: T.HALONEN RISES TO 23-MONTH HIGH IN BRISK DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: T.HALONEN RISES TO 23-MONTH HIGH IN BRISK DEMAND.

text.p: Shares in Finnish OTC-listed food stuffs equipment manufacturer Tuomo Halonen Oy rose to a 23-month high in active trade on Tuesday, boosted by interest in OTC-listed companies, brokers said.
"Investors now are on the look-out for OTC pearls," one broker said.
At 1530/1330 GMT, Halonen traded at 22.00 markka up two markka or 10 percent. Volume was healthy for Tuomo Halonen at 791,300 markka.
Brokers said the company's performance was good and the outlook for the future was bright. "I see quite a bit of potential in the share," one said.
Another broker speculated that one of the family owners might be selling a stake in the company.
"The share is normally extremely illiquid, therefore it seems obvious that one of the family owners is selling," he said.
